verdict.rationale: Clerky's own product docs say founders can issue SAFEs or convertible notes from its legal dashboard, and its software lets users customize key terms of the paperwork instead of drafting it. A community user also confirms a post-incorporation Fundraising package. However, nothing in the evidence specifically documents e-signing of SAFEs or notes; the signing evidence covers Partner API formations only. missing for 10: explicit documentation that SAFE/note templates use standard terms (e.g., YC-standard SAFE), documented in-app signing for SAFEs/convertible notes, independent hands-on corroboration of the SAFE/note workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate and sign SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms without drafting from scratch

citations.quote: Our software makes it easy to customize the key terms of the legal paperwork you're working on.
Clerky gives me management tools (including the post-incorporation package: Fundraising, Hiring and Maintenance)
